latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the "interrogate" skill.
- Guided questioning workflow: activated only by the explicit command `/interrogate`.
- Presents 4–15 adaptive, mutually exclusive questions in batches of 2, each with options A–D plus a write-in option.
- Adjusts questioning path based on prior answers, designed to clarify vague or complex requests before any action.
- Summarizes understanding and asks for confirmation before proceeding.
- Handles uncertainty and indecision by offering explanations and recommendations without repeating questions.
